features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 DEX; +2 CON.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; no size-based adjustments.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with hypello subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20-foot land speed. Armor and encumbrance never reduce base land speed; has 30-foot swim speed as separately described Swim trait.

effects.textValue: Land speed not reduced by armor or encumbrance

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common, Hypello. High-Intelligence options: Moogle, Goblin, Sylvan, Dwarven.

features.name: Camouflage
features.description: +4 racial Stealth checks in marshes or forested areas.

features.name: Hardy
features.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

features.name: Amphibians
features.description: Can breathe both air and water.

effects.textValue: Amphibious: can breathe air and water

features.name: Animal Empathy
features.description: +2 racial Handle Animal checks when attempting to influence animals.

features.name: Rider
features.description: +2 racial Ride checks.

features.name: Ride ze Shoopuf?
features.description: Handle Animal and Ride are always class skills.

features.name: Swamp Stride
features.description: Move through normal difficult terrain in a swamp at normal speed; magically altered terrain still slows normally.

effects.textValue: Ignore ordinary swamp difficult terrain; magical terrain still applies

features.name: Swim
features.description: Swim speed 30 feet; standard swim-speed racial +8 to Swim checks.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision to 60 feet.

features.name: Poor Communication
features.description: -2 on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks against all other races (not against Hypello).

condition.description: Interacting with a race other than Hypello
Interacting with a race other than Hypello

features.name: Defensive Training
features.description: +2 dodge AC against Large or larger animals or magical beasts. Replaces Swamp Stride.

condition.description: Attacked by Large+ animal or magical beast

features.name: Fishy Merchant
features.description: When conducting a trade, +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks and ignore Poor Communication. Replaces Animal Empathy and Rider (does not replace Poor Communication globally).

effects.textValue: Ignore Poor Communication only during trade

features.name: Glider
features.description: While falling, calculate falling damage as though distance was halved; can glide horizontally half the vertical distance. Does not function in heavy armor, heavy load or unable to react/helpless. Replaces Swamp Stride.

effects.textValue: Half falling distance for damage; horizontal drift=half vertical distance; heavy armor/load or helpless prevents use

features.name: Land Lubber
features.description: Increase land speed to 30 feet. Replaces Swim (30-ft swim speed and granted racial +8 Swim); does not explicitly remove Amphibians.

effects.textValue: land speed becomes 30 feet; requires overriding standard Base Speed 20 without removing its armor/encumbrance exception

features.name: Heritage Poroggo Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX; +2 INT.

features.name: Heritage Poroggo Alternate Traits
features.description: Small-sized Poroggo has +2 DEX/+2 INT instead of standard +2 DEX/+2 CON and +2 racial Spellcraft bonus instead of Rider bonus. Other unaffected Hypello traits remain; full size effect must use standard size rule.

choicePools.name: Bonus languages
choicePools.notes: Only eligible high-Intelligence choices. Count and repeated selections require standard language-rule audit.

alternateReplacements.description: Fishy Merchant: replaces Animal Empathy, Rider.

heritages.name: Poroggo
heritages.description: Small-sized Poroggo has +2 DEX/+2 INT instead of standard +2 DEX/+2 CON and +2 racial Spellcraft bonus instead of Rider bonus. Other unaffected Hypello traits remain; full size effect must use standard size rule.

favoredRewards.name: Hypello Archer favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1 foot bow/crossbow range increment; applies only after each block of 5 selections.

favoredRewards.name: Hypello Black Mage favored reward
favoredRewards.description: Learn one geomancer poison/water-descriptor spell at least one spell level below highest Black Mage spell level. Counts as one higher-level spell unless also on Black Mage list.

favoredRewards.name: Hypello Chocobo Knight favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1 mount HP; inherited by replacement mount.

favoredRewards.name: Hypello Fencer favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/3 bonus Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Fly, Ride and Swim checks.

favoredRewards.name: Hypello Geomancer favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/2 bonus concentration checks; double bonus in forest or swamp.

favoredRewards.name: Hypello Gunner favored reward
favoredRewards.description: +1/4 attack when performing utility shot or dead shot.
